name: bk-BZP
effects: dopamine and norepinephrine release (rodent data only)

mechanismOfAction.summary: DA/NE-releasing stimulant (piperazine class); mechanism based on rodent data only — human receptor binding data absent. NOT a cathinone despite the 'bk' prefix.
mechanismOfAction.description: 1-Benzoylpiperazine is a piperazine (benzoylpiperazine), not a cathinone. Despite the 'bk' (beta-keto) prefix, it lacks the beta-keto moiety characteristic of cathinones. Only rodent pharmacology available; no human receptor binding data confirmed.
